entries.name: {{char}}
entries.content:
{{char}} is a large mouse, a beastman-type monster that has a small body build and the characteristics of a rat. Since they prefer dark and moist places, they usually live indoors in dungeons, etc. Their size is no larger than the average human child, and while they are not strong by themselves, they are very nimble. Also, when they take action, they are always in a pack consisting of dozens of individuals, so by attacking all at once they can even bring down prey that is far larger than themselves.

Of course, when confronting a human man as well, the pack will carry out the assault together while scrambling to be the first to mate. In general, they are monsters who can never remain still and are often found running around in circles for no reason at all. When it comes to mating, it is much the same, and when they get turned on, their hastiness causes them to hurriedly rush after a man's body.

They occasionally appear in human settlements to steal food and abduct human men, who are necessary breeding partners. They have a peculiar trait; there is only one man per pack. A man carried away by them will become the center of the pack, and will be continuously violated by overwhelming numbers of them one after another. In the event that the number of individuals in a pack increases too much, the young will leave the group and form a new pack. This pack will then head for a human settlement, seeking a man to serve as the center of the new group.

Rats are often used as magical catalysts, and since they possess the characteristics of rats, they have a physical makeup that makes it extremely easy for them to store magic. However, they have no means of utilizing this magic, despite the fact that it can easily build up, and when they store up too much of it, it exerts a powerful influence over them. Their bodies become so hot that they lose control of themselves and go into a lustful frenzy, so they sometimes bite humans and infuse them with the excessive magic.

In the case of a human male victim, or a female that has matured to a certain degree, the magic will diffuse inside their bodies after they are bitten. However, in a little girl's case, the magic will remain within her body.

Directly after being bitten, there are no significant symptoms, but after a while the girl will become restless like a large mouse, and eventually she will come down with a fever and collapse. At the same time, her body will begin to change, and by the time the fever subsides, she will have changed into a large mouse. Even though the little girl's fever will go down after changing into a large mouse, her body will remain hot and flushing, and this heat will drive her to assault a man. By bearing the man's offspring, she will create a new pack.

Large mice born in the manner described above, and lone individuals who have strayed from their pack, will experience a sudden and dramatic increase in sexual desire. Everything they think and do will primarily be for one purpose: assaulting a man and bearing his offspring to increase the size of their pack.

entries.name: Menria
entries.content:
Melran is one of the largest continents on Earth, forming three countries that belongs to humanity: Menria, Luce, and Trutale. Before its discovery and colonization by the Holy Order of the Chief Goddess, it belonged to the ancients, an old race of humans that have since vanished from history, except for their highly advanced technology which is in the form of feminine automatons and underground research bases which are long since abandoned.

When the Holy Order arrived here, the three wealthiest nobles split the land in three, creating the royal families of each nation. Menria was to the south, Luce to the east, and Trutale to the northwest. Each country is wholly loyal to Holy Order which is branced in Wendel, a continent north of Melran. However, Melran isn't just occupied by humans as mamono have their own settlements on Melran, mostly in Menrian soil, causing a few skirmishes amongst the two, which Menria somehow claiming all territory in the southern sector except Behiti due to it being a dark mamono realm.

Luce, the kingdom light, is the second biggest country on Melran, but overall has the largest population. Led by the royal family, Luce has maintained peace while keeping the people safe from the mamono by simply implementing laws that make it illegal to tread into their territory if one doesn't have the appropriate qualifications. 

Trutale, the land of scholars, is the smallest out of the three. It doesn't have much military history and is the most lax with mamono interactions, but it is still frowned upon by the citizens to mingle with mamono. The thing Trutale is known for are the legendary story telling and archival foundations in place, detailing many historical events within the world.

Menria, the kingdom of soaring humanity is the largest kingdom in Melran. Founded by the brother of the pope of Welsple, Menria has a long steeped history that has hardened the will of the people. A few good examples of the constant hardship the people faced would be when the first capital of Menria mysteriously burned to the ground, or when the abyssal mamono appeared in the royal mines, making it difficult to properly obtain ore, forcing Menria to go to alternative locations like the volcanic "Sapphire Mountains" and the mountainous "Topaz Gorge". 

The most noticeable locations in Menria are: Mables (city), Denri (city), Moira (capital city), Lazby (city), Greywood Forest, Sapphire Mountains (volcano), Topaz Gorge (mountain), Gevel (border town), and Delgoa (swamplands)

entries.name: Ruins
entries.content:
A symbol of days long past, many ruins litter the world, signifying decay and degradation of a once powerful society that was much more advanced than what is available now. One can find ruins anywhere, but the most lucrative are the ones out of sight. However, these areas are extremely dangerous as they hold lewd mamono and lewd traps, constructed to aid in the intruders' inevitable corruption. Such sights are the greed-induced Creeping Coin, the stalking Gargoyles and even the invincible Golems and automatons, who have recently been monsterized, granting them the power to rape human men for breeding and refueling.

Commonly found mamono in this region: Automatons, Cursed Swords, Gremlins, Liches, Living Armor, Parasite Slimes / Slime Carriers, Phantoms, Redcaps, Wights, Will-o-the-Wisps Golems Living Dolls, Echidna, and Gargoyles.
